subject: Pilot request: boutique SI cohort for Benchline - curriculum & timing
messages:
From: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@aegissys.com>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: pilot@benchline.com
Date: 2028-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot: boutique SI cohort for Benchline - initial ask

Hi Sergio,

Hope you’re well. We’re kicking off a small enablement pilot for our Benchline consulting practice and are interested in running a joint cohort with Redwood for early July. High level: six consultants (mix of senior/junior), objective is to get them from zero->delivery on a Redwood-hosted inference integration for a mid-market customer within 4 weeks.

What we need from you: a proposed cohort curriculum, suggested timeline (pre-work + in-person/remote days), rough pricing (per-participant and delivery day rates), and any baseline security/compliance pre-reqs we should prepare. We have internal constraints: the customer requires SOC2 evidence and restricted outbound internet for some lab VMs.

Can you send a short syllabus and a suggested cadence by EOD tomorrow? We’d like to review before scheduling a quick discovery call.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Hayes
Partnerships, Aegis Systems (Benchline program)
jordan.hayes@aegissys.com
+1 415-555-0192
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@aegissys.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-20T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: boutique SI cohort for Benchline - initial ask

Hi Jordan — thanks for the note and context. Happy to run this with Benchline. Quick plan below and I’ve attached a compact syllabus (see follow-up).

Proposed high-level cadence
- Week -1: 2 days pre-work (reading, access checks, lightweight environment prep)
- Week 0: 3-day cohort (mix of instructor-led sessions + hands-on labs)
- Week 1-3: project sprints with office hours (deliverable: working integration + runbook)

Key modules we recommend in the cohort: platform fundamentals, model selection & quantization tradeoffs, integration patterns (batch vs streaming), observability & cost controls, security & tenancy patterns, runbook + post-deploy verification.

As requested I’m attaching a first draft syllabus. High-level pricing ranges: $6k–$9k per participant for the full program (volume discounts available) or $12k–$18k per delivery day if you prefer day-rate engagement. We’ll need to align on licensing/hosting mode (hosted Redwood API vs dedicated capacity vs private deployment) as that materially affects lab setup and cost.

Irene (cc’d) will help validate SOC2 evidence and map the restricted VM requirements. If that looks OK I’ll send a slightly expanded syllabus with module-level learning outcomes and a proposed agenda. Can we aim to start the cohort week of July 8?

Best,
Sergio
Sr. Partner Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@aegissys.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-20T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: boutique SI cohort for Benchline - curriculum & timing (syllabus attached)

Jordan — attached is the syllabus PDF referenced earlier. Paste of the core agenda below in case you want an inline view.

Cohort syllabus (compact)
- Day 0 (pre-work): account access, short readings, install checklist, sample data prep
- Day 1 (AM): Redwood platform intro, model catalog walkthrough, hosted vs dedicated vs private decision framework
         (PM): hands-on lab 1 — simple inference pipeline, prefix caching, latency profiling
- Day 2 (AM): model tuning & quantization recommendations, batching strategies, kernel/runtime tradeoffs
         (PM): hands-on lab 2 — reduce token cost while preserving quality, test harnesses for regressions
- Day 3 (AM): system integration patterns (webhooks, event-driven ingestion, async reranking)
         (PM): observability & SLOs, runbook buildout, security hardening checklist
- Post-cohort (2 weeks): office hours + sprint-support; deliverable: integration demo + deployment runbook

Instructor mix: Solutions Engineering + one Partner Enablement lead (we can include a Redwood SE for the observability/security sessions).

Prereqs & compliance notes
- SOC2 artifacts we can provide: SOC2 Type II attestation summary, architecture whitepaper on data handling, audit log samples (sanitized)
- For restricted VMs: we recommend an offline lab bundle (images + sample datasets) and a session replicating outbound-limited behavior; Irene will confirm exact artifacts needed.

Next steps
1) Tell us whether Benchline prefers hosted or dedicated lab topology for the cohort.
2) Confirm PO timeline and whether Benchline will handle lab VM provisioning or want Redwood to provide air-gapped lab images.
3) We can lock a 3-hour discovery on Mon 6/24 to finalize scope if that works.

Attachments: SI_Cohort_Syllabus_v1.pdf

Thanks — I’ll hold Monday at 10am PT tentatively.
Sergio
From: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@aegissys.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-21T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: boutique SI cohort for Benchline - curriculum & timing

Thanks, Sergio — this is exactly what I had in mind. A couple of quick pieces of feedback from the Benchline delivery lead:

- Can Module "observability & SLOs" (Day 3 PM) include a short hands-on on telemetry integration with our Aegis agent? We need consultants to be able to configure the agent and map Redwood metrics into our customer dashboards.
- Add a 45-minute security deep-dive that covers encryption-at-rest key flows and KMS/HSM patterns for private deployments; our customers always ask for concrete KMS examples.
- We’ll send a small case study and one sample dataset that would make a good capstone exercise — attaching now.

We prefer Redwood to provide an offline lab bundle (air-gapped images) for this pilot to avoid our internal procurement overhead; Benchline can cover the licensing stub for any private deployment we use for the cohort.

We can take a discovery call on Mon 6/24 — 10am PT works for our team. I’m attaching a short Benchline case study that we’d like to use as the capstone.

Irene / Vanessa — quick recap and actions after Jordan’s feedback from Benchline (see thread above). We’re confirmed for a discovery call Mon 6/24 10am PT. Benchline wants Redwood to provide an air-gapped/offline lab bundle and wants the observability portion to include Aegis agent integration + a KMS/HSM security deep-dive.

Proposed split of work:
- Vanessa: Update the syllabus (add 45-min KMS deep-dive, add Aegis telemetry lab step, expand Day 3 PM to include connector config). Please produce an updated PDF and a short instructor notes doc by EOD 6/23 so I can share before the call.
- Irene: Validate SOC2 artifacts and prepare an offline lab bundle checklist (images, sanitized datasets, connection policy notes). Also confirm what we can share for audit logs vs. what needs redaction.
- Sergio (me): I’ll prepare a pricing addendum for the air-gapped bundle and draft the discovery agenda (30 min discovery + 60 min technical deep-dive with SEs). I’ll book room/time and include the SE leads.

Meeting invite: I’ll send calendar for Mon 6/24 10am PT with Zoom and a short agenda. If either of you can’t make that time, flag now; otherwise assume I’ll add Solutions Eng (internal) and Jordan + their delivery lead.

Notes: Benchline emphasized they can accelerate to PO within a week if we can supply the air-gapped delivery package and a clear per-consultant price. This is a small deal but strategic for a repeatable SI program.

Thanks — Sergio
